posted_text:
💰 AI, Data Centers & Crypto
NC HB 920 — North Carolina OKs Digital Assets with a $750B Market Cap

North Carolina is paving the way for digital currencies with this law, requiring assets to meet strict criteria – including a $750 billion market cap, a 10-year track record, and robust security measures – to be recognized as a valid form of payment and protect consumer privacy when using them.

July 7, 2026: Signed by Gov.
